spec_match.rationale: The matrix runs the checks the subclass design exists to satisfy: instanceof ReadableStream by inheritance, meaningful instanceof WebTransportReceiveStream, capability detection via 'getStats' in x, and untouched reader methods.

interactive.rationale: One button evaluates every cell against a real plain ReadableStream and the real interface prototype, with needs-live-session cells explicitly marked rather than guessed.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Index blurb promises the compatibility matrix plus the feature-detect branches including Firefox's rejecting getStats; both sections deliver.

edge_cases.rationale: Covers no-interface builds, cross-realm-safe capability checks, the method-exists-but-rejects Firefox state, and asserts the consistency invariant that a plain stream must fail the new checks.

references.rationale: Links chromestatus, the spec interface, and the Streams spec's ReadableStream class.

conformance.rationale: The suite's plain-stream-not-receive-stream and inheritance assertions pin this page's matrix; honest 1 pass / 6 fail / 2 blocked on Chromium 141.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless Chromium 141 via the repo CDP harness (no chrome-devtools-mcp here): matrix run on desktop 1280×900 and mobile 360×740, overflowX 0, zero failed requests, clean console; the plain-stream column evaluated from a real stream and the verdict took the honest no-interface branch. Partial: the interface column's live values need a 158+ build.

telemetry_health.rationale: Asserts matrix consistency (plain stream fails every new-code check); no async leaks — the only stream constructed is local and closed.

design_system.rationale: CSS variables only; true/false cells pair emerald/rose with full text on bg-paper; needs-live-session cells use text-muted at AA on bg-paper.

accessibility.rationale: Captioned matrix with row/column th scope, native button, single polite verdict region, no color-only cells.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Driven at both classes with 0px horizontal overflow; expression row-headers word-break cleanly; both screenshots read.

openQuestions.title: Fill the subclass column with live-instance values on 158+
openQuestions.detail: On a Chrome 158+ or flagged build, the subclass column's prototype-derived answers should be re-verified, and — once any live HTTP/3 endpoint exists — the two needs-live-session cells should be run against a genuine instance (instanceof WebTransportReceiveStream true, getStats resolving).

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive comparison table narrow mobile no horizontal overflow
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Semantic table in an overflow wrapper with wrapping content and preserved header relationships.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: The 4-column matrix keeps caption + scope inside .table-wrap; expressions use word-break:break-all; page overflow measured 0px at 360px.

guidanceConsulted.query: accessible live region status readout for async API probe result
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Single polite live region; results as text, not color alone.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: The verdict is one aria-live output; every boolean cell prints true/false text with the color as reinforcement.

summary: Compatibility matrix over real objects plus the three feature-detect branches migration code needs. Verified with the repo headless-Chromium CDP harness (no chrome-devtools-mcp in this cloud environment) on Chromium 141: honest no-interface verdict, consistency invariant held, clean console/network, 0px overflow both classes.
